text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I am so sorry
that it ended up like this..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Though I never intended to slack on my efforts, I am filled with regret,
wondering if there was still more I could have done.
choice_data_list: There was nothing wrong with your running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Indeed,
I believe I was able to demonstrate my strength properly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is to build the strength to take 1st place.
I look forward to your continued guidance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...! Of course.
I don't intend to give up like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Using this frustration as a stepping stone, I will redouble my training efforts starting tomorrow, so I look forward to working with you.
